        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { isPublicRoute } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check.         "contents": "/**\n * Checks if a given pathname is a public route\n * @param pathname - The pathname to check (e.g., '/auth/login')\n * @returns True if the pathname matches a public route, false otherwise\n */\nexport const isPublicRoute = (pathname: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  // Exact match for root route\n  if (pathname === '/') {\n    return true;\n  }\n  // Check if pathname starts with any public route prefix\n  return PUBLIC_ROUTE_PREFIXES.some((prefix) =&gt; pathname.startsWith(prefix));\n};\n\n/**\n * Validates that an email address ends with an allowed CZU domain\n * @param email - The email address to validate\n * @returns True if the email ends with @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz, false otherwise\n */",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (!code) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(\"No code provided\")}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n  if (error) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has email identity linked\n  // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n  // Use the same supabase client to ensure we have the just-exchanged session\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n\n  // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n  const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n  const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? (hasEmail ? \"/protected\" : \"/auth/verify-email\");\n\n  redirect(redirectTo);\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  const identities = authUser.identities || [];\n  const hasEmailIdentity = identities.some(\n    (identity) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n  );\n\n  // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n  if (!hasEmailIdentity) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  // Get the public.users row and linked profile in a single query\n  const { data: publicUser } = await supabase\n    .from(\"users\")\n    .select(\"id, profiles(id)\")\n    .eq(\"auth_user_id\", user.sub)\n    .single();\n\n  // If no publicUser or no linked profile, redirect to pending approval\n  if (!publicUser || !publicUser.profiles || publicUser.profiles.length === 0) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Pending approval page\n * Shown to users who have verified their email but don't have a linked profile yet\n */\nexport default async function PendingApprovalPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile();\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(\"/protected\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-md\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-6\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n            &lt;h1 className=\"text-2xl font-bold\"&gt;Pending Approval&lt;/h1&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n              Your email address has been verified, but you need an admin to approve your account before you can access protected areas.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"rounded-lg border p-4 bg-muted/50\"&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-sm\"&gt;\n              Please contact an administrator to approve your email address. Once approved, you will be able to access all protected areas of the application.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Handles both sign-in and sign-up flows seamlessly\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton() {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: \"google\",\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(\"Google OAuth error:\", error);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n      // Note: User will be redirected to Google, so we don't reset loading state here\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Unexpected error:\", error);\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Button\n      type=\"button\"\n      onClick={handleGoogleLogin}\n      disabled={isLoading}\n      className=\"w-full\"\n      variant=\"outline\"\n    &gt;\n      {isLoading ?         "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users can link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n * Users with existing email identities can also access this page to add additional emails\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;VerifyEmailForm /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(\"Invalid type\")}&#96;);\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(\"Invalid token hash\")}&#96;);\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  redirect(\"/protected\");\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Validates that a redirect URL is safe (same-origin or relative path)\n * Prevents open redirect vulnerabilities by rejecting external URLs\n * @param url - The URL to validate (can be relative path or absolute URL)\n * @param origin - The origin of the current request\n * @returns The validated safe path, or null if validation fails\n */\nexport function validateRedirectUrl(url: string | null, origin: string): string | null {\n  if (!url) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Reject empty strings\n  if (url.trim() === \"\") {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Allow relative paths (starting with /)\n  if (url.startsWith(\"/\")) {\n    // Ensure it doesn't contain protocol-relative URLs or other schemes\n    if (url.includes(\"://\") || url.startsWith(\"//\") || url.startsWith(\"javascript:\")) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return url;\n  }\n\n  // For absolute URLs, check if they're same-origin\n  try {\n    const urlObj = new URL(url, origin);\n    const originObj = new URL(origin);\n\n    // Reject if protocol doesn't match (http vs https)\n    if (urlObj.protocol !== originObj.protocol) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Reject if host doesn't match\n    if (urlObj.host !== originObj.host) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Return the pathname + search + hash (same-origin URL is safe)\n    return urlObj.pathname + urlObj.search + urlObj.hash;\n  } catch {\n    // Invalid URL format\n    return null;\n  }\n}",
